title: Gold on the Road
description: A wealthy merchant named Talbot Ashe has hired the Iron Company to guard him and his cargo traveling from Dalhurst to Thornfield. Bandits have been raiding the eastern roads. Your job: protect Ashe at all costs. Multiple ambushes are expected along the route.

objectives.description: Meet Talbot Ashe in the Dalhurst market
Escort Ashe safely to Thornfield (keep him alive!)
Report mission success to Captain Steele

notes: Rank: Private -> Corporal. Escort quest using EscortNPC system. Ashe waits in the Dalhurst market. Ambush trigger zones along route spawn bandits. Quest fails if Ashe dies.
